title: pp.shiftlfo~
description: `pp.shiftlfo~` is an LFO for generating irregular rhythmic patterns, with a signal output ranging from -1 to 1. Its frequency can be set by a signal or in hertz through the control-message inlet, while parameters such as hold, shift, rise, fall, curves, and phase shape the pattern; its GUI can save and recall up to 20 presets with the parent patch.
